sentences.text:
Author: K.Lakshman
Bench: K.Lakshman
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Lakshman
 Writ Petition No.1273 of 2021
Order:

Sri S.Ram Mohan, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home, has filed G.O.Rt.No.503, dated 03.03.2021, issued by the Principal Secretary to the Government, General Administration Department, wherein it is stated that the Government have duly considered the opinion and report of the Advisory Board and revoked the detention order in respect of the petitioner herein under Section 12(2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders, Land Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders,
Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Document Offenders,
Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime Offenders and While Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 and directed for release of the detenu.

entities.text: Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In view of the same, learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the grievance of the petitioner is redressed and sought to close the Writ Petition.
Recording the said submission, and placing the said GO on record, this Writ Petition is closed.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Writ petition, shall stand closed.

JUSTICE K.LAKSHMAN Date: 05.03.2021 TJMR P. Prabhaker And Another vs The State Of Telangana And 3 Others on 5 March, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57044040/
